messages:
Maya: Heads-up — AtlasOps EBR prep. Meeting Tue 11am PT. Need slide owners and a concise renewal risk summary.
Eli: Can we do a 15-min exec dry run Mon 4pm? prefer to catch any ask that needs eng.
Sam: I can cover integration perf + recent latency improvements. I'll need 2 slides (perf + ops runbook).
Maya: Great. Sam — assign `perf-slides.md` in the deck, keep to one chart + 3 bullets.
Jordan: From customer lens — onboarding still blocked by SSO edge-case we reported. Impact: limited user seat ramp. Renewal signal = neutral->at-risk if not resolved in 2 wks.
Eli: @Jordan can you paste repro steps here? I'll loop in Eng on Monday.
Jordan: repro: SAML assertion failing when username contains `+`. Workaround = use email instead. Repro steps attached in thread.
Sam: Noted — we can add a mitigation note to the ops slide. ETA for fix? I can triage Mon and aim for patch by Wed.
Maya: Action items:
- Eli: coordinate dry run Mon 4pm and capture exec asks
- Sam: perf + ops slides by EOD Mon
- Jordan: send a 1-paragraph renewal impact statement by EOD Fri
- Maya: I'll own exec readout and QBR narrative
Please add if missing.
Eli: Suggest adding short customer quote slide. @Jordan can you share 1-2 lines of sentiment we can show? :memo:
Jordan: sure — will share two short quotes by EOD.
cs-bot: Reminder: deck template v2 uploaded to `drive.redwood/ebr_templates/atlasops.v2.pptx` — permissions: team/customer-success view+comment
Maya: Also capture enablement asks — CS enablement wants an onboarding playbook check. @Eli can you sync with Enablement to add a 10-min demo in QBR?
Eli: Yep will loop in Priya from Enablement and send calendar invite.
Sam: Small note — can we include token-cost deltas for the recommended quantization? ops wants $$ impact. I'll add a table.
Maya: Perfect. Last ask: if renewal risk moves to at-risk, escalation path = AE + CSM + CS Ops + product SLA review. I'll draft escalation template after dry run.
Jordan: Thanks all. Appreciate quick turnaround. :pray:
Maya: Thanks — ping here when slides are uploaded. :thumbsup:
